questions.stemEn: A child has an image showing absent radius with preserved thumb. Which CBC abnormality is expected?
questions.explanationAr: وجود absent radius مع thumb موجود يوحي في التجميع بـ TAR pattern، وبالتالي المتوقع thrombocytopenia. الصورة ضرورية للسؤال.
questions.clinicalPearl: Absent radius with present thumb is a classic imaging clue for TAR syndrome.

questions.stemEn: A patient has recurrent bleeding, thrombocytopenia, and high MPV. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع يختار Bernard-Soulier syndrome بسبب thrombocytopenia مع large platelets/high MPV، لكنه يذكر أن MYH9-related disease قد يعطي صورة مشابهة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Macrothrombocytopenia narrows the differential but is not specific to one disorder.

questions.stemEn: A patient has recurrent bleeding with thrombocytopenia and low MPV. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: الـ low MPV مع thrombocytopenia هو clue مهم في التجميع لـ Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome.
questions.clinicalPearl: WAS is classically associated with thrombocytopenia and small platelets.

questions.stemEn: A child has eczema, recurrent infections, thrombocytopenia, and low MPV. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanationAr: eczema + recurrent infections + thrombocytopenia with small platelets هو pattern الكلاسيكي في التجميع لـ Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome.
questions.clinicalPearl: Think WAS when eczema, infection susceptibility, and microthrombocytopenia occur together.

questions.stemEn: A boy labeled as having chronic ITP is found to have unusually small platelets. What should be ordered next?
questions.explanationAr: small platelet size في ولد لديه thrombocytopenia يرفع الشك في WAS/X-linked thrombocytopenia؛ لذلك التجميع يختار WAS gene testing.
questions.clinicalPearl: Microthrombocytopenia in a boy should prompt consideration of WAS/XLT rather than assuming ITP.

questions.stemEn: A child has recurrent epistaxis and ecchymosis with normal CBC, PT and aPTT, but abnormal PFA-100 and platelet aggregation studies. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: الـ normal platelet count مع severe platelet function abnormality يتماشى في التجميع مع Glanzmann thrombasthenia.
questions.clinicalPearl: Glanzmann classically has normal platelet count and abnormal aggregation with most agonists except ristocetin.

questions.stemEn: A child presents one week after a URTI with severe gum bleeding and platelet count 5,000/mm3, without organomegaly or lymphadenopathy. What is the next step?
questions.explanationAr: وجود significant mucosal bleeding مع severe thrombocytopenia في صورة ITP يجعل التجميع يختار IVIG كعلاج سريع لرفع platelets.
questions.clinicalPearl: ITP treatment depends more on bleeding severity than on platelet count alone.

questions.stemEn: A child develops petechiae after a recent URTI. Platelets are low and bone marrow shows increased megakaryocytes. What is the next step in management?
questions.explanationAr: التجميع يختار IVIG، لكن شدة النزف غير مذكورة هنا؛ لذلك نحتفظ بالإجابة كمفتاح recalled ونضع السؤال للمراجعة قبل النشر.
questions.clinicalPearl: In ITP, increased megakaryocytes may be seen, but treatment choice requires bleeding severity and clinical context.

questions.clinicalPearl: VWD is a key cause of heavy menstrual bleeding in adolescents with lifelong mucocutaneous bleeding.

questions.stemEn: A 4-week-old newborn presents with seizures and subdural bleeding. There was prior umbilical stump bleeding, while CBC and routine coagulation studies are normal. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanationAr: bleeding مع PT وaPTT طبيعيين ووجود umbilical stump bleeding هو clue قوي في التجميع لـ Factor XIII deficiency.
questions.clinicalPearl: Factor XIII deficiency can cause severe bleeding despite normal PT and aPTT.

questions.stemEn: A previously healthy boy with no bleeding history is found to have an isolated prolonged aPTT before tonsillectomy. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanationAr: الملف يرجّح Factor XII deficiency لأنه يطيل aPTT بدون bleeding tendency، لكنه يذكر Factor XI كاحتمال أيضًا. لذلك السؤال يبقى conflicting حتى التحقق.
questions.clinicalPearl: An isolated prolonged aPTT without bleeding history can reflect a contact factor deficiency such as factor XII.

questions.stemEn: A 9-month-old has knee swelling and a prior intramuscular post-vaccination hematoma. Which laboratory finding is most likely?

questions.clinicalPearl: Deep tissue bleeding and hemarthrosis point toward coagulation factor deficiency rather than platelet dysfunction.
